free.q: Is it really free? What's the catch?
free.a: There is none. Since your computer does the work, there are no expensive servers to pay for: no subscription, no watermark, no ads. The code is even public (open source)

formats.a: Videos from your phone, your camera or your screen recordings: MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV. The result is an MP4 file that plays everywhere

browsers.a: Chrome or Edge on a computer give the best experience. Firefox and Safari work too, with a few extra clicks to reopen a video. On a phone, stick to short videos

size.q: Is there a file size limit?
size.a: There is no upload limit since nothing is uploaded. The video is read from disk in small pieces; the practical limit is your computer's memory and patience for very long videos

offline.a: Yes. The first time, the subtitle tool downloads, just once. After that everything works offline, and you can even install it as an app

ai.q: How can the AI run without a server?
ai.a: The AI models (Whisper for subtitles, MediaPipe for faces) are downloaded once, then your computer runs them. Your voice and your images never leave it

capcut.q: How is it different from CapCut?
capcut.a: LocalCutVideo focuses on what talking-head videos need (silences cut, automatic subtitles, vertical format), with no account and without uploading your videos. For special effects, animated transitions or trendy templates, CapCut is more complete

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: LocalCutVideo is built so that your videos never leave your device. This page explains plainly what is processed, and where.

sections.title: In short
body: No upload: your videos, audio and transcripts are processed in your browser and are never sent to the publisher or to anyone else.
No account, no cookies, no analytics, no advertising.

sections.title: What stays on your device
body: The video and audio files you open are read directly from your disk. Analysis, transcription (Whisper), face tracking and export are computed locally by your browser.

Your projects (cuts, transcript, settings) are saved in your browser's local database (IndexedDB), along with a thumbnail and a cache of analyses. The publisher has no access to them. You can delete a project from the projects page, or erase everything by clearing this site's data in your browser settings.

sections.title: Local storage
body: The application stores your interface preferences (language, theme, last opened project) in your browser's local storage, and keeps its own files and the downloaded AI models in the browser cache so it can work offline. These are strictly necessary for the service, are never used to track you, and therefore require no consent banner.

sections.title: Server
body: The server only delivers the application's files and keeps no access logs. Like any web server, it technically receives your IP address to answer requests, but does not store it.

sections.title: Third parties
body: Hugging Face: the Whisper model is served by this site, like the rest of the application. Only if it is not available here is it downloaded from huggingface.co instead; Hugging Face then receives your IP address and standard browser information, but never your audio. See their [privacy policy](https://huggingface.co/privacy).
GitHub: only if you follow a link to the source code repository.
No other third party is contacted: a strict Content-Security-Policy technically prevents the page from connecting anywhere else.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, and to object to its processing. As the publisher holds no data about you, there is usually nothing to access, but you can ask any question at maxence.bonnici@outlook.fr. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL ([cnil.fr](https://www.cnil.fr)) or the data protection authority of your country.

sections.title: Changes
body: This policy may be updated when the application evolves. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using LocalCutVideo, you accept these terms. They are short because the service is simple: a free tool running in your browser.

sections.title: Service
body: LocalCutVideo is a free video editing application that runs entirely in your web browser. It is provided free of charge, without an account, and may evolve, be interrupted or stop at any time without notice.

sections.title: Your content
body: You remain the sole owner of, and solely responsible for, the videos, sounds and music you edit and publish. You must hold the necessary rights (copyright, music licenses, image rights of the people filmed).
The application must not be used for unlawful purposes.

sections.title: Automatic features
body: Transcription, subtitles, silence detection and auto-framing are produced automatically and may contain errors. Check the result before publishing it.

sections.title: Your files and projects
body: The application never modifies your original files. Projects are stored in your browser and may be lost if its data is cleared or if the browser frees up space: always keep your original files.

sections.title: Warranty and liability
body: The software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, under the MIT license. To the extent permitted by law, the publisher cannot be held liable for any damage resulting from the use of, or the inability to use, the application (data loss, export errors, unavailability…).
